sentences.text: Heard learned counsels for the parties.

FIR in Crime No.44/2024 was registered by Balaganoor Police Station, Raichur initially for offence punishable under section 363 of IPC against unknown person on the basis of the first information dated 14.04.2024 received from respondent No.2 herein who is the mother of the victim girl aged 17 years.
4. During the course of investigation, the victim girl and the petitioner were traced.
The petitioner was arrested on 03.05.2024 and subsequently remanded for judicial custody.
Investigation of the case is completed and charge sheet has been filed against the petitioner for the aforesaid offences.

sentences.text: Bail application filed by the petitioner before the trial court in Crl.Misc.No.5295/2024 was rejected on 22.08.2024.
Therefore, the petitioner is before this Court.
5. Learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that prosecution has failed to prove the age of the victim girl.
Petitioner aged about 20 years is a student and is in custody for the last more than eight months.
NC: 2025:KHC-K:104 Investigation of the case is completed, accordingly prays to allow the petition.

6. Per contra, learned HCGP has opposed the petition and submits that victim who is a minor has made allegation against the petitioner in her statement recorded under section 164 of Cr.P.C.
7.
Respondent No.2, who is served in the matter, has remained unrepresented before this Court.

8. The first informant who is the mother of the victim girl, had approached the police on 14.04.2024 and in the first information, it is stated that victim girl had completed her II year PUC examination and on 06.04.2024, she had gone to her college but not returned home thereafter.
Efforts made to trace her had failed and therefore on 14.04.2024, first informant had approached the police.
9. During the course of investigation, the petitioner and the victim girl were traced.
Victim girl was subjected to medical examination and her statement under section 164 NC: 2025:KHC-K:104 of Cr.P.C was also recorded.
Investigation of the case is completed and charge sheet has been filed.

Though the victim girl, as on the date of FIR, had completed her II year PUC education, for the reasons best known for the prosecution, her SSLC marks card is not produced in the present case to prove her age.
Surprisingly, the prosecution has produced the school admission Register of the victim girl and also the application filed by the parents of the victim girl seeking admission in the school.
The application for admission to the school is dated 06.06.2006 whereas date of the birth of the girl is mentioned as 06.09.2006.
There is alteration of the date found in the application for admission.
10. It is not in dispute that the petitioner is a student and the victim girl herself has stated that she got acquainted with the petitioner while she was studying in her college.
Petitioner has produced material before this Court to show that, he is a student studying his B.Com degree course.

Material on record would go to show that NC: 2025:KHC-K:104 victim girl and the petitioner are acquainted to each other and they had gone to Chikkamagaluru and had stayed together for a period of nearly 20 days.
11.
Petitioner aged about 20 years is in custody for the last more than 8 months.
He has no other criminal antecedent.
His continued detention is likely to have a serious adverse impact on his future prospects and career.
12. Under the circumstances, I am of the view his prayer for grant of regular bail needs to be answered affirmatively.

Accordingly, I proceed to pass the following:
